description: This Java class 'PasswordSecret' encapsulates secret information related to password credentials, including hash functions, password hashes, plain passwords, and salts. It provides getters, setters, validation, and encoding functionalities within a credential management context.

classes.name: PasswordSecret
classes.description: Represents secret information for password credentials, including hash function, password hash, plain password, and salt, with validation and encoding capabilities.

methods.name: getHashFunction
methods.description: Returns the cryptographic hash function used for this password secret.

methods.name: setHashFunction
methods.description: Sets the cryptographic hash function to use for this password secret.

methods.name: getPasswordPlain
methods.description: Returns the plain text password if set.

methods.name: toStringHelper
methods.description: Provides a string representation helper including secrets details.

methods.name: checkValidity
methods.description: Validates that the secret's properties are correctly set, throwing exceptions if invalid.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the plain text password into hashed form using the provided encoder.
